'''''Bravo Fighter''''' was the an [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] attached to [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]<ref name="CCG: Theed Palace Limited" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] happens in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] used the fighter during the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]].<ref name="SWE1">{{Film|I}}</ref>

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
''Bravo Fighter'' appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] but was first identified as such in ''[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]''.
